intro: There was no ICO for ERG. Every ERG is created according to a fixed schedule, written into the protocol from day one: each new block “prints” a set amount of ERG, and that amount shrinks over time until it reaches zero. In total there will only ever be {{max}} ERG.

stats.lockedSub: Paid out to miners over time

schedule.title: The emission schedule
schedule.rule1: {{rate}} ERG per block for the first {{period}} blocks (~2 years at 2-minute blocks).
schedule.rule2: After that, every {{epoch}} blocks (~3 months) the emission drops by {{drop}} ERG.
schedule.rule3: Once it hits 0 — at block {{end}} — new emission stops.
schedule.chartTitle: ERG created per block, by height
schedule.chartLabel: ERG emitted per block by height
schedule.p2: Unlike Bitcoin, which abruptly “halves” every 4 years, Ergo's curve steps down in small, even stairs. And instead of stretching over more than a century, all ERG is emitted in about 8 years — after which network security relies on transaction fees (and re-emission, see below).

treasury.title: The treasury share
treasury.p1: In the early years, a small part of every block went to a treasury to fund development: {{t1}} ERG/block for the first {{period}} blocks, then {{t2}} and {{t3}} ERG over the next two epochs. Miners received the rest ({{miner}} ERG/block). From block {{from}} onwards, the entire emission goes to miners.

eip27.title: EIP-27: re-emission
eip27.p1: The original schedule had a problem: emission ends fairly early, while transaction fees might not be enough to keep miners around. EIP-27, activated by a soft fork at block {{height}} (in 2022), “saves” part of today's reward to pay it out gradually in the future:
eip27.li1: If the block's emission is ≥ 15 ERG: 12 ERG is locked into the re-emission contract.
eip27.li2: If it is below 15 ERG: (emission − 3) ERG is locked, so the miner always gets at least 3 ERG.
eip27.li3: After emission ends (block {{start}}), the contract pays {{per}} ERG per block back to miners until it runs dry.
eip27.p2: In total, EIP-27 locks about {{total}} ERG. Paid out at {{per}} ERG per block, that lasts roughly another {{blocks}} blocks — until around block {{end}} (≈ {{year}}). The total supply doesn't change; only the timing of when ERG reaches miners is stretched out.

miner.title: How much does a miner actually get?
miner.text: Take block {{h}}: {{e}} ERG emitted, {{l}} ERG locked, and the miner receives {{m}} ERG + transaction fees. Open any block to see the emission, reemitted and reward fields.

outro: Want the numbers at a specific height? Use the <calc>emission calculator</calc>. The dates above are estimates assuming 2-minute blocks — real timing can drift by a few weeks.
